Inspect the Figma node `https://www.figma.com/design/E5wvyUAbALMujNbO4Lssbw/IdoMods-rekrutacja-frontend-AI--Copy-?node-id=1-506&t=lDcWsO5BiE6halRJ-4` using `Framelink_Figma_MCP` (`get_figma_data` and `download_figma_images`).
- Pass an **absolute local path** to `download_figma_images` for `./assets/images` (e.g., `/absolute/path/to/project/assets/images`), and reference all downloaded assets in `index.html` using **relative paths** (`./assets/images/...`).
- Keep the project zero-build (or simple to run locally) with semantic HTML5, Tailwind CSS, and Vanilla JavaScript (ES6+).

First, inspect the Figma frame and assets, present a concise plan of the HTML structure, Tailwind classes, and JS interactions, and then create/update `index.html` implementing:

### 1. Header Hover State (250 ms, `ease-in-out`)
- Default state: transparent background over the hero, white text, icons, and logo.
- On hover over the header/menu: background transitions `transparent -> #FFFFFF` (`250 ms`, `ease-in-out`).
- Simultaneously, text, icons, and logo transition `white -> black` (`250 ms`, `ease-in-out`) for high contrast.
- On pointer leave: smoothly returns (`250 ms`, `ease-in-out`).

### 2. Hero Slider & Progress Bar
- Responsive Hero section (desktop, tablet, mobile) using layout, typography, colors, spacing, and slide/lamp assets from the Figma frame.
- Autoplay every `3 s` (`3000 ms`) with prev/next controls if present in Figma.
- Crossfade between slides: `600 ms`, `ease-in-out` (`opacity`).
- Subtle image scale `1.05 -> 1.0` during slide transition: `800 ms`, `ease-out` (`transform`).
- Yellow progress bar fills linearly over `3 s` (`3000 ms` linear) and resets cleanly on every slide change.

### 3. Interactive Lamps on the Hero Banner (e.g., First Banner)
- Cursor movement (`pointermove` in Vanilla JS): lamps smoothly move/parallax with cursor motion using GPU-friendly `transform: translate3d(...)` and reset smoothly on pointer leave.
- Click / keyboard toggle (`click` / `aria-pressed`): clicking a lamp toggles its lit/on state (warm glow/highlight transition within `200–250 ms` `ease-in-out` / `500 ms` `ease-out` for glow spread) without interfering with slider navigation.
